text: He remembered the hands held out for the chains. His friend trusted him without asking for another promise. Water came slowly through a crack in the rock. Mellows drank, got onto his knees and stood up. He managed one step, then took another. At the city gates, the bell rang for his friend's death. He raced to the square where the sword was already raised above his friend.
